Kuwait school holidays 2026–2027

Shows the days and hours until the next break for students or teachers, the school days left, and every holiday this year with return dates.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

How many days to the holiday?

Kuwait school calendar 2026–2027

EventDatesLengthReturn
Grade 1 startsSun, 13 Sept 2026——
Semester 1 (other grades)Mon, 14 Sept 2026 – Thu, 21 Jan 2027——
Kindergarten startsWed, 16 Sept 2026——
Mid-year breakSun, 24 Jan 2027 – Thu, 4 Feb 202712 daysBack Sun, 7 Feb 2027

The official calendar leaves out National Day, Liberation Day, Isra and Mi'raj and both Eids, which the Cabinet announces; the countdown adds them from the expected official holidays. Teachers' summer holiday runs from 1 July to 4 September 2027.

Frequently asked questions

When is the 2027 mid-year break in Kuwait?

From Sunday 24 January to Thursday 4 February 2027 (12 days, 16 with the weekends), with the second term starting on Sunday 7 February, under the Education Ministry's calendar.
